3802.grammar: nt, abstr, comp, from anamatagga, neg
3802.meaning1: fact of having no conceivable beginning
3802.construction:
anu + na > a + mata + agga + iya
anamatagga + iya

examples.text: anamataggo'yaṃ bhikkhave, saṃsāro. pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.

3804.grammar: prp of na namati, neg, intrans

examples.text: k'āyaṃ eḷagalāgumbe, karoti ahuhāsiyaṃ, na'y'idha naccaṃ vā gītaṃ vā, tāḷaṃ vā susamāhitaṃ, anamhikāle sussoṇi, kiṃ nu jagghasi sobhaṇe.

3806.meaning1: not time for smiling; not time for amusement

examples.text: k'āyaṃ eḷagalāgumbe, karoti ahuhāsiyaṃ, na'y'idha naccaṃ vā gītaṃ vā, tāḷaṃ vā susamāhitaṃ, anamhikāle sussoṇi, kiṃ nu jagghasi sobhaṇe.
taggha'si, tāta kumma, khato, taggha upahato. etena hi te, tāta kumma, suttakena pitaro ca pitāmahā ca anayaṃ āpannā byasanaṃ āpannā. gaccha dāni tvaṃ, tāta kumma, na dāni tvaṃ amhākan'ti.
evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, makkaṭo pañc'oḍḍito thunaṃ seti anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo luddassa.

3809.grammar: nt, act, from na asati, neg
3809.commentary: (THa) na'y'idaṃ anayena jīvitan'ti idaṃ mama jīvitaṃ anayena añāyena veḷudāna-pupphadān'ādi-anesanāya na hoti jīvitanikantiyā abhāvato.
3809.notes: wrong reading for anasana, see Norman EV note 123

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ anayena jīvitaṃ, n'āhāro hadayassa santiko, āhāraṭṭhitiko samussayo, iti disvāna carāmi esanaṃ.

3810.meaning1: misfortune and disaster; tragedy and ruin

examples.text: m'āyaṃ puriso idh'eva anayabyasanaṃ āpajjī'ti!
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sālo vā dhavo vā phandano vā tīhi māluvālatāhi uddhasto pariyonaddho anayaṃ āpajjati, byasanaṃ āpajjati, anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.

3811.meaning1: got into trouble; met with misfortune; fallen into difficulty

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ime pañca kāmaguṇe gathitā mucchitā ajjhopannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti, te evam'assu veditabbā, anayam'āpannā byasanam'āpannā yathākāmakaraṇīyā pāpimato.

3812.meaning1: not an awakened being; unenlightened person

examples.text: mayañ'hi pubbe assamaṇā'va samānā samaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, abrāhmaṇā'va samānā brāhmaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, anarahanto'va samānā arahant'amhā'ti paṭijānimha.

3814.grammar: masc, nom sg of na arahant, neg
3814.construction:
na > an + √arah + ant + aṃ
anarahant + aṃ
3814.commentary: (MNa) kilesārīnaṃ ahatattā anarahanto'y'eva samānā'ti attho. (SNPa) anarahaṃ santo'ti akhīṇ'āsavo samāno.

examples.text: yo ve anarahaṃ santo, arahaṃ paṭijānāti, coro sabrahmake loke, eso kho vasal'ādhamo.
na kāmasukham'anuyuñjeyya hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamath'ānuyogam'anuyuñjeyya dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.
nassa padassa tappurise an ādeso hoti sare pare. na asso anasso, anissaro, anariyo.
duggame visame vā'pi, ariyā gacchanti kāmada, anariyā visame magge, papatanti avaṃsirā, ariyānaṃ samo maggo, ariyā hi visame samā'ti.

3817.meaning1: with ignoble qualities, attacking; (or) ignobly attacking the good qualities
3817.commentary: (ANa) anariyaguṇam'āsajjā'ti anariyaguṇakathaṃ guṇam'āsajja kathenti. guṇaṃ ghaṭṭetvā kathā hi anariyakathā nāma, na ariyakathā, taṃ kathentī'ti attho.

examples.text: ye viruddhā sallapanti, viniviṭṭhā samussitā, anariyaguṇam'āsajja, añño'ññavivar'esino.
yo attano sīlavatāni jantu, anānupuṭṭho'va paresa pāva, anariyadhammaṃ kusalā tam'āhu, yo ātumānaṃ sayam'eva pāva.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammaṃ'y'eva pariyesati, attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhammaṃ'y'eva pariyesati, attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhammaṃ'y'eva pariyesati, attanā saṃkilesadhammo samāno saṃkilesadhammaṃ'y'eva pariyesati. imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso anariyapariyesanā.
yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ idaṃ vuccati kāmasukhaṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ puthujjanasukhaṃ anariyasukhaṃ.

3821.meaning1: ignoble mode of expression; untrue statement; communication without integrity
3821.commentary: (VINa) anariyavohārā'ti anariyānaṃ bālaputhujjanānaṃ vohārā (ANa) anariyavohārā'ti na ariyakathā sadosakathā. yāhi cetanāhi te vohāre voharanti, tāsaṃ etaṃ nāmaṃ.

examples.text: sampajānamusāvādo nāma visaṃvādanapurekkhārassa vācā, girā, byappatho, vacībhedo, vācasikā viññatti, aṭṭha anariyavohārā, adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhaṃ me'ti, assutaṃ sutaṃ me'ti, amutaṃ mutaṃ me'ti

3824.grammar: adj, comp, from na alaṅkaroti, neg (+loc)

examples.text: mahaddhanā mahābhogā, raṭṭhavanto'pi khattiyā, aññam'aññ'ābhigijjhanti, kāmesu analaṅ'katā.

3825.grammar: pp of na alaṅkaroti, comp vb, neg

3826.grammar: abs of na alaṅkaroti, comp vb, neg, trans (+acc)
3826.meaning1: having not found suitable; having found to be unworthy; having found unsatisfactory
3826.construction:
na > an + alaṃ + karitvā
na + alaṅkaritvā
3826.commentary: (MNa) analaṅ'karitvā'ti alaṃ iminā, alaṃ iminā'ti punappunaṃ alaṅ'karitvā.

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, taṃ dhammaṃ analaṅ'karitvā tasmā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.

3827.meaning1: and is not able (to); and is not possible (to); and is incapable (of)

examples.text: ambho purisa, ubbhataṃ kho te sallaṃ, apanīto visadoso anupādiseso. analañ'ca te antarāyāya.

3828.grammar: adj, from na lasati, neg x2
3828.synonym: akilāsu, akusīta, atandita, uṭṭhānaka, uṭṭhāhaka, vīra, vīriyavant

examples.text: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo ye te bhattu abbhantarā kamm'antā, uṇṇā'ti vā kappāsā'ti vā, tattha dakkhā hoti analasā tatr'upāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgatā alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.

3829.meaning1: not enough; not sufficient; (comm) (or) not to be relied on
3829.commentary: (MNa) analan'ti vadāmī'ti akattabbaālayan'ti vadāmi, taṇh'ālayo ettha na uppādetabbo'ti dasseti. atha vā analaṃ apariyattaṃ, na ettāvatā alam'etan'ti sanniṭṭhānaṃ kātabban'ti vadāmi.

examples.text: idh'udāyi, bhikkhu vivicc'eva kāmehi… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, idaṃ kho ahaṃ, udāyi, analan'ti vadāmi, pajahathā'ti vadāmi, samatikkamathā'ti vadāmi. ko ca tassa samatikkamo?

3830.meaning1: with a dry body; with dry limbs

examples.text: dhammo rahado brāhmaṇa sīlatittho, anāvilo sabbhi sataṃ pasattho, yattha have vedaguno sinātā, anallagattā'va taranti pāraṃ.
dhammo rahado brāhmaṇa sīlatittho, anāvilo sabbhi sataṃ pasattho, yattha have vedaguno sinātā, anallīnagattā'va taranti pāraṃ.

3833.commentary: (SNPa) ye hi te tayo rogā pure āsuṃ, icchā anasanaṃ jarā, kiñci kiñci'd'eva patthanataṇhā ca khudā ca paripākajarā cā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: tayo rogā pure āsuṃ, icchā anasanaṃ jarā, pasūnañ'ca samārambhā, aṭṭhānavutim'āgamuṃ.
manussā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, kathañ'hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā na mattaṃ jānitvā paṭiggahessanti! ime imesaṃ datvā app'ekadā anasitā acchantī'ti!!

3836.grammar: opt of na atthi, neg, intrans (+nom)
3836.meaning1: might be lost; may be destroyed
3836.commentary: (MNa) manaṃ vata, bho, anassāmā'ti, bho, sace mayaṃ na upasaṅkameyyāma, iminā thokena anupasaṅkamanamattena apayirupāsanamatten'eva naṭṭhā bhaveyyāma.

examples.text: te evam'āhaṃsu, manaṃ vata, bho, anassāma, manaṃ vata, bho, panassāma.

3837.grammar: prp of na assasati, neg, intrans
3837.meaning1: unconsoled; discouraged; lacking confidence; not convinced
3837.commentary: (SNa) anassasan'ti naṭṭho, panassasan'ti atinaṭṭho. (SNa) anassasan'ti nassasiṃ, naṭṭho nām'amhi icc'eva attho.
3837.notes: The commentary takes the meaning to √nas (perish) which is not morphologically viable.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, etth'āhaṃ, bhante, anassasaṃ panassasaṃ. ahañ'hi, bhante, channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāmī'ti.
buddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ vacanaṃ byappathaṃ desanaṃ anusiṭṭhiṃ na ādiyanti na sussusanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, anassavā avacanakarā paṭilomavuttino, aññen'eva mukhaṃ karonti.

3839.grammar: opt 1st pl of na assa, neg, intrans (+nom)
3839.meaning1: we might not be; we may not be
3839.construction:
na > an + assa + āma
na + assāma
3839.commentary: (MNa) manaṃ vata, bho, anassāmā'ti, bho, sace mayaṃ na upasaṅkameyyāma, iminā thokena anupasaṅkamanamattena apayirupāsanamatten'eva naṭṭhā bhaveyyāma.

examples.text: te evam'āhaṃsu, manaṃ vata, bho, anassāma, manaṃ vata, bho, panassāma.

3840.meaning1: suffocating; not getting one's breath; unable to breathe
3840.meaning2: not getting one's breath; unable to breathe
3840.construction:
na > an + ā + √sas > sās + *a + ka
anassāsa + ka

examples.text: ty'āhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi, tena hi, bho, imaṃ purisaṃ jīvantaṃ'y'eva tulāya tuletvā jiyāya anassāsakaṃ māretvā puna'd'eva tulāya tulethā'ti.
tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sattarasavaggiyaṃ bhikkhuṃ aṅgulipatodakena hāsesuṃ. so bhikkhu uttanto anassāsako kālam'akāsi.

3841.meaning1: not consoling; not giving comfort; not providing relief; not trustworthy
3841.construction:
na > an + ā + √sas > sās + *a + ika
anassāsa + ika

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ kho ahaṃ, āvuso, abalaṃ virāgunaṃ anassāsikan'ti viditvā ye viññāṇe upāy'ūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittan'ti pajānāmi.
sātiyesu anassāvī, atimāne ca no yuto, saṇho ca paṭibhānavā, na saddho na virajjati.

ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho abhayo rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, bhāseyya nu kho, bhante, tathāgato taṃ vācaṃ yā sā vācā paresaṃ appiyā amanāpā'ti? na khv'ettha, rājakumāra, ek'aṃsenā'ti. ettha, bhante, anassuṃ nigaṇṭhā'ti.

3844.commentary: (MNa) anavakāso'ti paccayapaṭikkhepo. ubhayenā'pi kāraṇam'eva paṭikkhipati. kāraṇañ'hi tadāyattavuttitāya attano phalassa ṭhānan'ti ca avakāso'ti ca vuccati.

examples.text: aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ tathāgato aparisuddhāya parisāya uposathaṃ kareyya, pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya
so tena ñāṇadassanena na majjati nappamajjati na pamādaṃ āpajjati, appamatto samāno asamayavimokkhaṃ ārādheti. aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu tāya asamayavimuttiyā parihāyetha.

3845.grammar: fem, abstr, from na avakāsa, neg
3845.construction:
na > an + ava + √kās + a + tā
anavakāsa + tā

examples.text: atha kho jayaseno rājakumāro aciravatassa samaṇ'uddesassa aṭṭhānatañ'ca anavakāsatañ'ca pavedetvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkāmi.

3846.meaning1: not immersed (in); not steeped (in); not filled (with)

examples.text: rūpañ'ca h'idaṃ, mahāli, ek'antadukkhaṃ abhavissa dukkh'ānupatitaṃ dukkh'āvakkantaṃ anavakkantaṃ sukhena, na'y'idaṃ sattā rūpasmiṃ sārajjeyyuṃ.

3849.synonym: akāraka, agarahiya, adūsika, anāgu, anindita, anupakuṭṭha, anupakkuṭṭha, appaduṭṭha

examples.text: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
sīlabbataṃ vā'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, kammañ'ca sāvajj'anavajjam'etaṃ, suddhiṃ asuddhin'ti apatthayāno, virato care santim'anuggahāya.

3850.grammar: nt, ptp of na ava √vad, neg

examples.text: bhuñjati anavajjāni, sāvajjāni na bhuñjati, ghāsam'acchādanaṃ laddhā, sannidhiṃ parivajjayaṃ.
so attānaṃ'y'eva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, att'ādhipateyyaṃ.

3851.grammar: fem, abstr, from na avajja, neg
3851.construction:
na > an + ava + √vad + ya + tā
anavajja + tā

examples.text: iti purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāma navañ'ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāma yātrā ca no bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsu vihāro cā'ti
katamāni cattāri? paññābalaṃ, vīriyabalaṃ, anavajjabalaṃ, saṅgahabalaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri balānī'ti.
katamaṃ anavajjabalaṃ? kāmacchandassa pahīnattā nekkhamme n'atthi kiñci vajjanti, anavajjabalaṃ.
ye imesaṃ bhavataṃ dhammā kusalā kusalasaṅkhātā, anavajjā anavajjasaṅkhātā, sevitabbā sevitabbasaṅkhātā, alam'ariyā alam'ariyasaṅkhātā, sukkā sukkasaṅkhātā.

3854.meaning1: blameless happiness; pleasure of being faultless

examples.text: cattār'imāni, gahapati, sukhāni adhigamanīyāni gihinā kāmabhoginā kālena kālaṃ samayena samayaṃ upādāya. katamāni cattāri? atthisukhaṃ, bhogasukhaṃ, ānaṇyasukhaṃ, anavajjasukhaṃ.
katamañ'ca, gahapati, anavajjasukhaṃ? idha, gahapati, ariyasāvako anavajjena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, anavajjena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, anavajjena manokammena samannāgato hoti.

3855.grammar: fem, abstr, from na avañāpeti, neg, caus
3855.commentary: (ANa) aho vata maṃ pare na avajāneyyun'ti evaṃ uppanno vitakko anavaññattipaṭisaṃyutto vitakko nāma. (ANa) anavaññattikāmo'ti abhiññātabhāvakāmo.

examples.text: tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno sukhumasahagatā upakkilesā ñātivitakko janapadavitakko anavaññattipaṭisaṃyutto vitakko

3856.meaning1: wanting respect; desiring recognition; wishing for social standing
3856.meaning2: wishing not to be despised, not to be disregarded
3856.commentary: (ANa) anavaññattikāmo'ti abhiññātabhāvakāmo. (ANa) anavaññattikāmo'ti aho vata maṃ aññena avajāneyyun'ti anavajānanakāmo.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, ānanda, pāpabhikkhu lābhakāmo hoti sakkārakāmo anavaññattikāmo.

3857.meaning1: concerning one's reputation; about one's social standing

examples.text: tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno sukhumasahagatā upakkilesā ñātivitakko janapadavitakko anavaññattipaṭisaṃyutto vitakko
anavaññatti-paṭisaṃyutta-vitakkavaḍḍhanan'ti, sabbaṃ taṃ takkavaḍḍhanaṃ.

3858.meaning1: gaining recognition; winning respect; getting a reputation

examples.text: so uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyamati anavaññappaṭilābhāya lābha-sakkāra-siloka-ppaṭilābhāya.

3859.grammar: fem, abstr, from na avajānāti, neg
3859.commentary: (ANa) aho vata maṃ pare na avajāneyyun'ti evaṃ uppanno vitakko anavaññattipaṭisaṃyutto vitakko nāma.

examples.text: so mah'iccho samāno vighātavā asantuṭṭho itarītara-cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārena pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati anavaññappaṭilābhāya lābha-sakkāra-siloka-ppaṭilābhāya

3860.meaning1: not despised; not disrespected; not looked down upon (by)

examples.text: ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ, buddhappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, dhammappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, saṅghappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ cittīkataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.
akkhitto'ti jātiṃ ārabbha kiṃ so'ti kenaci anavaññāto. anupakkuṭṭho'ti jātisandosavādena anupakkuṭṭhapubbo.

3861.meaning1: unstable; ungrounded; ephemeral; not dependable; unreliable

examples.text: anavaṭṭhitacittassa, saddhammaṃ avijānato, pariplavapasādassa, paññā na paripūrati.
sabbasaṅkhārā ca me anavaṭṭhitato khāyissanti, sabbaloke ca me mano n'ābhiramissati, sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati

3862.grammar: fem, abstr, from na avaṭṭhita, neg
3862.construction:
na > an + ava + √ṭhā + ita + tā
anavaṭṭhita + tā

examples.text: pure'ti niggahakālato pubbe. acārī'ti vicari, anavaṭṭhitatāya nān'ārammaṇesu paribbhami. cārikan'ti yathākāmacariyaṃ.

3864.meaning2: wandering in an unsettled way (not staying long anywhere)

examples.text: kamm'antaṃ kāreti, adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyati, pāmokkhesu bhikkhūsu paṭiviruddho hoti, dīghacārikaṃ anavatthacārikaṃ anuyutto viharati, nappaṭibalo hoti kālena kālaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ.

3865.meaning1: unstable; ungrounded; ephemeral; not dependable; unreliable

examples.text: sabbasaṅkhārā ca me anavatthitā khāyissanti, sabbaloke ca me mano n'ābhiramissati, sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati

3867.synonym: apacita, garu, garuka, garukata, garubhāvaniya, garubhāvanīya, garusammata, guru, purakkhata, bhāvaniya, bhāvanīya, mānita, vandayata, vandita, sakkata, sambhāvita, sammata
3867.commentary: (DNa) anavamatenā'ti anavaññātena. anapamodenā'ti'pi pāṭho, na appamodena, na dīnena na gabbhitenā'ti attho.

examples.text: dānam'pi c'atthacariyatañ'ca, piyavāditañ'ca samānattatañ'ca, kariyacariyasusaṅgahaṃ bahūnaṃ, anavamatena guṇena yāti saggaṃ.

3868.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from na avamaññati, neg, caus
3868.meaning1: not disrespecting; not belittling; not having contempt
3868.commentary: (DNa) anavamānanāyā'ti yathā dāsakammakar'ādayo pothetvā viheṭhetvā kathenti, evaṃ hīḷetvā vimānetvā akathanena.

examples.text: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi sāmikena pacchimā disā bhariyā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, sammānanāya anavamānanāya anaticariyāya issariyavossaggena alaṅ'kār'ānuppadānena.

3869.construction:
na > an + ava + √yu > yav + *a
anavayava > anavaya
3869.commentary: (MNa) anavayo'ti imesu lok'āyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anūno paripūrakārī, avayo na hotī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. avayo nāma yo tāni atthato ca ganthato ca sandhāretuṃ na sakkoti.
3869.notes:
(ABH) na + vyaya 'not decaying'
(Cone) anavaka 'not a novice'

examples.text: tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lok'āyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.

3871.grammar: ind, adv, from acc sg of avarata, neg

examples.text: ye keci pāṇabhūt'atthi, tasā vā thāvarā vā anavasesā, dīghā vā y'eva mahantā vā, majjhimā rassakā aṇukathūlā.

3873.meaning1: without remainder; with nothing left over

3874.commentary: (ANa) anavasesadohī ca hotī'ti paṇḍitagopālakena hi yāva vacchakassa maṃsalohitaṃ saṇṭhāti, tāva ekaṃ dve thane ṭhapetvā sāvasesadohinā bhavitabbaṃ.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, gopālako… na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī ca hoti, ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.

3875.meaning1: who has no restraint in accepting requisites
3875.commentary: (ANa) anavasesadohī hotī'ti paṭiggahaṇe mattaṃ ajānanto anavasesaṃ duhati.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti, na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ hāretā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī ca hoti

examples.text: saḷ'eva phass'āyatanāni bhikkhavo, asaṃvuto yattha dukkhaṃ nigacchati, tesañ'ca ye saṃvaraṇaṃ avedisuṃ, saddhādutiyā viharanta-anavassutā.
anavassutacittassa, ananvāhatacetaso, puññapāpapahīnassa, n'atthi jāgarato bhayaṃ.
tatra, bhikkhave, tathāgato na c'eva anattamano hoti, na ca anattamanataṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, anavassuto ca viharati sato sampajāno.

3888.meaning1: not crowded (with); not hemmed in (with); not surrounded (by)

3889.meaning1: not overcrowded; not full of; unobstructed; unhindered; (comm) not entangled

examples.text: migo yathā seri sucittakānane, rammaṃ giriṃ pāvus'ābbhamāliniṃ, anākule tattha nage ramissaṃ, asaṃsayaṃ citta parābhavissasi.
mātāpitu upaṭṭhānaṃ, puttadārassa saṅgaho, anākulā ca kamm'antā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

3890.meaning1: not come; not arrived; not present
3890.commentary: (ANa) anāgataṃ bhāraṃ vahatī'ti… imaṃ dasavidhaṃ therabhāraṃ navako hutvā therena anajjhiṭṭho karonto anāgataṃ bhāraṃ vahati nāma.

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, bālā. katame dve? yo ca anāgataṃ bhāraṃ vahati, yo ca āgataṃ bhāraṃ na vahati. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve bālā'ti.
kin'ti anāgatā ca pesalā sabrahmacārī āgaccheyyuṃ āgatā ca pesalā sabrahmacārī phāsuṃ vihareyyun'ti
kathañ'ca, thera, ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti. idha, thera, yaṃ atītaṃ taṃ pahīnaṃ, yaṃ anāgataṃ taṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, paccuppannesu ca attabhāvapaṭilābhesu chandarāgo suppaṭivinīto.
ahañ'c'eva kho pana anāgataṃ rūpaṃ abhinandeyyaṃ, anāgatam'p'āhaṃ addhānaṃ evam'eva rūpena khajjeyyaṃ, seyyathā'pi eta'r'ahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmī'ti
